peak.label: Peak-hour traffic
peak.derivation: 2 x maximum of the 24 published hourly network-arc means

medium.label: Medium traffic
medium.derivation: 2 x the published daily mean hourly network-arc flow

light.label: Light traffic
light.derivation: round(2 x arithmetic mean of hourly network-arc means at 00:00 through 05:00)

short_note: 5T Turin profile, 9 Oct 2026. Two-direction crossing proxy.
caveat: Modelled citywide network-arc estimates, not directly measured crossing-lane counts. Two-direction conversion assumes two representative arcs. One Friday profile is not an annual traffic distribution.

source.title: 5T / Muoversi a Torino: I numeri della mobilita, Flussi medi
source.provider: 5T Srl for the City of Torino
source.source_units: modelled mean vehicles/hour per network arc (road section)
source.method: Supervisore mathematical traffic model informed by travel surveys and fixed traffic detectors
source.update_schedule: 08:00 for the preceding day; same weekday of prior week also published
source.license: No dataset-specific open licence verified for this page; numeric facts transformed with attribution

conversion.assumption: Represent each of two simulated directions by one city-average network arc; total demand is twice the published arc flow. No source lane-count normalization is claimed.
conversion.rounding: Nearest integer vehicle/hour for light; peak and medium already integer

caveats: Source-calibrated scenario proxies, not observed demand at an individual pedestrian crossing.
Modelled citywide network-arc averages, not directly measured per-lane flow; local roads differ in lane count and demand.
Peak is a temporal maximum in published hourly estimates for one weekday, not a spatial-counter percentile or annual design peak.
Levels come from one Friday, not a representative annual or multi-day sample.
Hour24 repeats hour0 in the chart. This extra point is excluded from calculations.
Medium uses the separately published rounded daily mean; the mean of rounded hourly values can differ slightly.
Traffic presets do not validate annual operating hours, street-specific demand, benefit attribution, or economic assumptions.
